Bug_Title: Virtual threads should not run tasks that include synchronized code
Bug_Explanation: The bug is present in the enqueue and enqueue2 methods, where a virtual thread is started that contains a synchronized block and a call to a synchronized method, respectively. This behavior can cause the underlying OS thread to be blocked during a blocking operation, impacting the scalability of the application.
